claim: Flower colour is represented hierarchically as pigmentation presence and pigmented-only optical intensity.
Environment plus continuous spatial structure provides the nationwide natural predictive baseline.
claim_ceiling: predictive baseline; not complete causal partition

claim: Adding the Bombus fingerprint yields a mean cross-fitted AUC change of -0.0019.
claim_ceiling: habitat-support fingerprint; not abundance or visitation

claim: In the lower-third Bombus-limitation gate, environmentally matched Bombus-available cells had pigmentation share 0.223 higher than Bombus-limited cells (upper-tail p=0.017; across-grid BH q=0.102). Pigmented-only intensity differed by approximately -0.615 (p=0.905).
claim_ceiling: predicted Bombus-availability contrast after local environmental matching; lower-third gate adopted after exploratory design development; not abundance, visitation, pigment-cost measurement, or causal selection

claim: Eighteen pre-fixed local pigmented isolates were identified (fraction 0.0501). The held-out cross-fitted reference gave count p=0.136 and fraction p=0.049 (Monte Carlo 95% interval 0.045-0.053); the same-fold sensitivity gave fraction p=0.048. A full-data joint spatial posterior-predictive check gave count p=0.222 and fraction p=0.123 (Monte Carlo 95% interval 0.121-0.125). Because the fraction did not show a robust upper-tail departure across predictive references, the isolates are retained as follow-up candidates rather than evidence of excess occurrence or horticultural provenance.
claim_ceiling: candidate definition and predictive-model checking; not evidence of introduction, planting, or horticultural origin

claim: Local 5-km population and DID alignment had corrected p-values 0.102 and 0.060; these characterize post-selection human context rather than provenance.
claim_ceiling: exploratory local placement tendency; not human-mediated origin

claim: Images and public landscape layers do not demonstrate planting, horticultural origin, escape, introgression, or genetic pollution.
claim_ceiling: requires field history, specimens, and population genetics
